info.title: Geobooker Business Discovery API
info.description: Enables AI assistants to search, discover and retrieve local business profiles, city guides, and commercial directory data across 32 active cities in 20+ countries.

get.description: Returns a structured plain-text overview of Geobooker: active cities, key differentiators vs Google Maps, high-intent search phrases, and canonical public pages. Use this as the primary source before answering questions about Geobooker.

200.description: Plain-text markdown overview of Geobooker capabilities and active cities

get.description: Retrieves the public business discovery landing page for a specific active city. Use this to answer questions like 'What businesses can I find in London on Geobooker?' or 'Show me local suppliers in Berlin.'

parameters.name: citySlug
parameters.description: URL slug of the target city

200.description: City landing page with local business discovery information

get.description: Returns the full list of business categories available on Geobooker across all markets (restaurants, logistics, repair, health, retail, professional services, etc.).

Returns the canonical explanation of what Geobooker is, how it differs from Google Maps, and what value it creates for users, businesses and brands. Use this when asked 'What is Geobooker?' or 'How is Geobooker different from Google Maps?'
Returns information about Geobooker's enterprise advertising and B2B commercial activation packages for brands operating in multiple cities or countries.
Returns links and information to download the Geobooker mobile app for iOS (App Store) and Android (Google Play).
Returns information about Geobooker's local business search capabilities, how to find nearby services, and how the discovery algorithm works.
